app-templates.message:
test(explainer): two of each instead of 60 pages

## Intent

A 60-page fixture took 4:43 in CI: too long for CI and far too long for pre-push. Tests must stay fast enough for both and still cover every structure and block type.

## Key changes

- The fixture explainer-all-blocks has two chapters of two pages, in German and English, with two section levels and every block type on every page, so each block type appears four times, with previous and next across chapters.
- It replaces the 60-page fixture; the longest CI job goes from 4:43 to 1:23.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same intent: tooling#56 lets lernapps check visit every page of a bundle.

tooling.reason: Both commits of tooling#56, one after the other: the change to the visit, and a smaller, faster test of it.
tooling.message:
feat(check): visit every page of a bundle; on a URL, say when the limit stops the visit

## Intent

lernapps check stopped at 100 pages and skipped the rest silently, against the rule of no silent cutoff, so a large explainer bundle would have gone partly unchecked. The test of the page limit should also stay small, so hooks stay fast.

## Key changes

- A bundle has a finite list of pages, so its check visits all of them: first those reachable by links from the start page, then every other .html file.
- A page no link reaches is an error of the new rule pages-reachable; a page marked noindex is checked but need not be reached; the 404 page and files without a doctype are not pages.
- On a URL the limit of 100 pages stays, and reaching it gives a hint of the same rule instead of stopping silently.
- Pages are visited four at a time, in the order a single visit would take, so reports stay deterministic.
- The tooling's own tests can lower the limit on a URL through an environment variable, not a flag and not in the help. A five-page app with a limit of 3 proves the same as a 120-page app did, in about 5 s instead of 35 s, so the test moves to the fast set.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same intent: app-templates#14 shrinks the explainer fixture to two of each.
